[01-overview.md]
# Brightwater Cycles: company overview
Brightwater Cycles designs and sells electric bikes. The head office is in Port Alder. The company was founded in 2016. It sells three models: the Commuter, the Ridgeline and the Cargo Lite. Bikes are sold directly online and through 40 partner shops.


[05-product-cargo-lite.md]
# Product: Cargo Lite
The Cargo Lite is a cargo e-bike for families and deliveries. Price: $3,200. It carries up to 120 kg of load. Range: 70 km on one charge.


[02-history.md]
# Company history
Maya Okafor and Tomasz Wren founded Brightwater Cycles in 2016 in a rented garage in Port Alder. The first bike, the Commuter, shipped in 2017. The Ridgeline followed in 2020 and the Cargo Lite in 2023. In 2024 the company opened a second factory in Lindqvist.


[15-pricing-2026.md]
# Price change, March 2026
From 1 March 2026 the price of the Ridgeline rises by 8 percent, because Nordcell battery cells cost more than the old cells. The prices of the Commuter and the Cargo Lite do not change.


[03-product-commuter.md]
# Product: Commuter
The Commuter is a city e-bike. Price: $1,450. Motor: 250 W. Range: 60 km on one charge. Weight: 21 kg. It is the best-selling model, about half of all bikes sold.
